svg.text: JORDANIAN CITIZENS · DoS LABOUR FORCE SURVEY · 2025–2026
Ground colour = rate · Disc area = number of unemployed Jordanians
DoS published Ma'an's Q2 2026 quarterly rate separately: 33.2%. Different period and basis; not comparable.
DoS publishes no sampling error; small governorates can move several points year to year.
Amman: 19.1%, but 155,900 people (36%). Amman, Irbid and Zarqa hold 70%.
Source: DoS PxWeb EMPALL1/EMPALL, 2025 annual (Jordanians 15+); Q2 2026 release for Ma'an 33.2%. Boundaries: geoBoundaries (CC BY 2.5).
